infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Road to Sale uses the microphone to listen for coaching cues during your sales session.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Road to Sale uses speech recognition to automatically detect completed steps in your NADA checklist.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Road to Sale uses the camera to capture trade-in vehicle photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Road to Sale saves trade-in photos to your photo library.
